svg.title: Drizzlet hidden options guide
svg.desc: Four pages of mix knob settings with quality LED [A] colour and blink indications. Full text version in OPTIONS.md.

g.text: FEEDBACK, DRY/WET, REVERB, then all three.
3. [A] shows each stored value in turn. Turn a
mix knob (not a big knob) to change it.
4. Close: hold [M] 3 seconds or press another
button. On page 1 with Pitch scale on Scale,
tap SEED to step the scale.
It saves by itself; wait before powering off.
Move a knob a little before it responds.
on: it resets all settings to
Hold [A], turn FEEDBACK. With an input
patched, a long [A] press returns to
Hold [A], turn REVERB; fully CCW is
none. [M] can route CV to it.
Synth start Manual, no inputs, FREEZE
